text:
Sam R: heads-up: GPU provisioning in us-west-3 is failing during bootstrap this morning. new nodes hit token/assume-role errors and never register. saw ~20 fails starting 09:07 UTC. :grimacing:
Ivy N: saw alerts. we rolled out the "role-bound egress" endpoint policy last night (INF-8002) to enforce principal-based VPC endpoint restrictions. suspected it may be denying the nodes STS assume role calls.
Carlos D: grabbed node-init log: 
```
May 12 09:08:12 cloud-init[1]: ERR failed to get creds: POST https://sts-vpc.internal/assume -> 403 Forbidden
May 12 09:08:12 cloud-init[1]: ERR auditstream dial tcp 10.2.3.12:443: connection refused
```
Sam R: so two failures: STS 403 and auditstream unreachable. are those two services covered by the new endpoint policy?
Ivy N: policy allowed service principals tagged with team:infra and role=bootstrap but the node bootstrap uses an ephemeral instance profile with role=init-node (not team:infra). policy matched on principal tags, not role name. that mismatch caused the endpoint deny.
Elaine P: oof. we enforced strict principal tag checks to reduce blast radius (good), but didn't include the init-node profile. quick fix options:
- add init-node principal to endpoint allowlist (targeted, fast)
- relax principal tag checks for the warm-pool subnets (broader, fast)
- revert policy entirely (fastest, worst security)
Carlos D: also auditstream is behind a private endpoint that uses host-based egress rules; if STS is blocked, node never gets temp creds to auth to auditstream and may appear as connection refused. chain reaction.
Sam R: propose canary: add init-node principal and auditstream host to endpoint allowlist, apply to one AZ warm-pool only, spin up 6 nodes, watch registration and audit backlog drain.
Ivy N: agree. terraform snippet to patch endpoint policy:```hcl
resource "vpc_endpoint_policy" "stsaudit_allow_canary" {
  endpoint_id = "vpce-xxxx"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [
      {Effect = "Allow", Principal = {AWS = "arn:aws:iam::123456:role/init-node"}, Action = "sts:AssumeRole", Resource = "*"},
      {Effect = "Allow", Principal = "*", Action = "logs:PutRecord", Resource = "arn:aws:logs:*:*:auditstream/*", Condition = {StringEquals = {"aws:SourceVpc" : "vpc-zzzz"}}}
    ]
  })
  ttl = "2h"
}
```
Carlos D: caution: wide resource or principal = "*" lines might be too permissive. keep exact ARN where possible. Also add a short TTL so we don't forget.
Elaine P: cost/regulatory note: auditstream traffic can't go through public NAT. so NAT-based fallback is out. must fix endpoint policy or proxy inside VPC.
FinanceBot: FYI NAT per-AZ baseline ~$0.06/hr; adding exceptions is cheaper operationally for short fixes.
Sam R: ok tasks: Ivy apply canary patch to one AZ; Carlos create 6-node warm-pool canary (tag: endpoint-canary=usw3); Elaine watch audit collector and kubelet. timeframe: 20-25m.
DeployBot: Created incident INF-9555 "us-west-3 gpu bootstrap blocked by vpc endpoint principal policy" assigned to @Ivy N and @Carlos D. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9555 :rotating_light:
Ivy N: applying policy diff now, will post JSON diff. :hammer_and_wrench:
Sam R: when patch applied, also capture the last 10 kubelet and cloud-init lines if any failure.
Ivy N: patch live for az-b warm-pool. canary request created.
Carlos D: canaries registered at 09:27 UTC. audit backlog drained within ~5m. no further 403s. marking canary green. :white_check_mark:
Elaine P: action items: 1) update endpoint policy to include init-node ARN across all warm-pools, 2) add preflight check that validates principal ARNs against endpoint policy before bake, 3) add smoke test that runs assume-role+audit put during fw/endpoint policy changes.
Sam R: +1 on preflight. add an automated alert if principals referenced in infra PRs are not included in endpoint policies.
FinanceBot: I'll model cost impact of long-term proxy vs endpoint exceptions; short term cost is negligible.
Ivy N: opening PR to roll out the principal addition and the preflight. ETA today evening.
Sam R: thanks all. closing thread after PR merged and runbook updated.
